caption: Portrait photography tutorial memory for planning expression, lighting, pose, lens choice and background separation before post-production. Use diffused or golden-hour light for gentle portraits, short-telephoto or shallow-depth setups when flattering facial proportion is important, and test lighting before the subject enters the scene.
positive_aesthetic_notes: portrait quality starts before retouching: light, pose, expression and background must be coherent
soft or diffused light protects skin texture and lowers retouching burden
background separation supports a clear subject anchor
negative_failure_notes: do not rely on heavy retouching to repair bad light or confused pose
avoid harsh mixed lighting that makes skin color inconsistent
do not blur the background so much that scene identity disappears when context matters
text_accuracy_notes: No visible text target. For portrait briefs, list exact mood, subject, wardrobe and scene constraints.
layout_notes: Frame for eyes, facial angle, shoulder line, hands and background geometry before styling.

caption: Portrait focus and pose memory: prioritize sharp eyes, stable facial plane, flattering shoulder angle, controlled headroom and believable body posture. Lens and aperture choices should support the desired subject-background relationship rather than creating accidental distortion.
positive_aesthetic_notes: eye sharpness is a hard quality gate for portraits
shoulder and head angle control can improve balance without body distortion
top crop and headroom must be intentional, not accidental
negative_failure_notes: avoid warped body proportions from aggressive wide-angle close-ups
do not let ears, nose or background become sharper than the eyes in a portrait
avoid black-hole clothing areas that steal attention from the face
layout_notes: Check eyes, nose plane, chin, shoulder line, hands, clothing mass, headroom and edge crop before retouching.

caption: Natural portrait retouching recipe: remove temporary blemishes and distractions, preserve pores and skin texture, keep facial identity, protect hair detail, maintain original light direction and avoid plastic smoothing. Use local masks before global grading and keep batch consistency across a portrait set.
positive_aesthetic_notes: blemish cleanup should be local and reversible in visual logic
skin texture preservation is more valuable than unreal smoothness
human-region consistency matters when retouching a series
negative_failure_notes: avoid plastic skin, erased pores, waxy cheeks and over-bright eyes
do not reshape identity or anatomy as a default beauty operation
avoid global smoothing that spreads onto hair, fabric or background
text_accuracy_notes: No visible text target. Record exact retouch request: blemish cleanup, skin tone, under-eye, hair flyaway, clothing wrinkle, background cleanup.
layout_notes: Work in order: exposure and white balance, geometry/crop, local cleanup, skin texture, eyes/hair/clothing, final color grade.

caption: Product photography setup memory for controlled studio or window-light environments: clean white or neutral background, tripod consistency, reflector or flag control, readable labels, sharp product edges, accurate white balance and repeatable framing across product series.
positive_aesthetic_notes: controlled environment and clean background make product details inspectable
tripod and fixed setup improve catalog consistency
reflector and flag choices define edge readability on white or glossy objects
negative_failure_notes: avoid uncontrolled reflections, color casts and distracting background seams
do not erase product grounding shadow until the object floats unnaturally
do not invent or distort label text during generated product retouching
text_accuracy_notes: Product labels, brand marks and ingredient text must be supplied as exact source assets or replaced with placeholders.
layout_notes: Set product as one anchor, leave catalog breathing room, keep verticals straight and product scale consistent.

caption: Product post-production memory for correcting exposure, white balance, background cleanliness, label readability, material texture, highlight roll-off, reflection shape and edge contour. Retouch should make the product more inspectable, not more fictional.
positive_aesthetic_notes: material accuracy and edge clarity are the main product retouching goals
background cleanup should support, not erase, the product silhouette
reflection control should reveal form and surface finish
negative_failure_notes: avoid blown highlights on glossy packaging or metal
do not warp product geometry or label typography
avoid over-cleaning surfaces so material feels synthetic
text_accuracy_notes: All visible product copy must be source-verified. AI-generated pseudo-labels are failure cases.
layout_notes: Compare before/after for edge contour, label plane, highlight shape, shadow contact and color cast.

caption: Composition optimization memory for cropping, straightening, perspective correction, rule-of-thirds balance, leading lines, depth, and subject breathing room. Use crop and perspective tools to clarify hierarchy, not to create unnatural geometry or amputated subject edges.
positive_aesthetic_notes: composition correction should strengthen focal hierarchy and reduce distractions
perspective and crop must keep human/product geometry believable
negative space can be used intentionally for text or editorial layout
negative_failure_notes: avoid over-cropping hands, sleeves, product edges or hair in ways that look accidental
do not fill crop edges with content that contradicts the scene
avoid extreme perspective correction that stretches bodies or products
text_accuracy_notes: If composition leaves space for title or caption, define exact text separately.
layout_notes: Check horizon, verticals, subject eye line, leading lines, frame edges, empty space, aspect ratio and output platform.

caption: Hanfu cultural portrait memory: match costume, hairstyle, makeup, prop, location and light into one coherent scene. Favor ancient architecture, garden, lakeside, window light, soft backlight, classical gestures, fan/book/umbrella props when appropriate, and composition that preserves garment silhouette and sleeve movement.
positive_aesthetic_notes: Hanfu portrait quality depends on costume-scene-prop coherence, not costume alone
soft natural light and architecture or garden context can build cultural atmosphere
pose should show sleeve, collar, waistline and headpiece structure clearly
negative_failure_notes: avoid generic costume cosplay without cultural scene logic
do not use random modern props, neon signs or mismatched hairstyle unless the concept is deliberately contemporary
avoid cutting sleeves, hem, umbrella or hair ornament at awkward frame edges
text_accuracy_notes: No fake calligraphy or invented historical inscriptions. If signage or poem text appears, require exact source text.
layout_notes: Frame full-body, half-body and detail shots separately; preserve garment line, face expression, hand gesture, prop edge and background rhythm.

caption: AI photo-editing governance memory for future model-assisted retouching: separate human region, clothing, hair, background and product planes; preserve identity, local texture and lighting consistency; record before/after pairs and rejected edits for training; evaluate both single-image quality and series consistency.
positive_aesthetic_notes: segmented region awareness prevents global retouch damage
before/after pairs and rejected examples are essential for retouching training
series consistency is a separate quality target beyond one beautiful image
negative_failure_notes: avoid automated beauty filters as the default training target
do not let local edits leak into unrelated regions
avoid inconsistent skin tone, lighting or product color across a set
text_accuracy_notes: Use metadata to document user intent and protected identity constraints.
layout_notes: Future comparison sets should pair original, mask, retouched result, and quality notes.
